Version: up to and including 1.3.6 (1.3.6 affected only if installed from source or binaries compiled before 7/17/19)
Method of Attack: Arbitrary file copy vulnerability via SITE CPFR and SITE CPTO commands allowing authenticated users (including anonymous if enabled) to copy files without write permission
Remote code execution by copying PHP code to a web-accessible directory and executing it
Filling up available storage by repeatedly copying files
Impacted Systems: ProFTPD servers up to version 1.3.6 installed prior to 7/17/19
Attack Vector: Authenticated user access to ProFTPD server (user account or anonymous if enabled)
Exploitation of mod_copy module's SITE CPFR and SITE CPTO commands ignoring 'Limit WRITE' denyall directives
Indicators of Compromise: Example attack copying welcome.msg to malicious.php
